title: A Survey on Evaluation of LLM-based Agents
authors_zh: Asaf Yehudai, Lilach Eden, Alan Li, Guy Uziel, Yilun Zhao, Roy Bar-Haim, Arman Cohan, Michal Shmueli-Scheuer
paper_type_zh: LLM 智能体评测综述与资源索引
best_for_zh: 设计、复核或比较网页、软件工程、工具调用与通用智能体评测的研究者。
one_line: Surveys LLM-agent evaluation across core capabilities, application domains, benchmark dimensions, and development-time evaluation frameworks.
从能力、应用、基准维度与开发框架四个层面梳理 LLM 智能体评测。
why: It provides a structured way to distinguish evaluation data, environment dynamics, interfaces, metrics, and safety before comparing agent benchmarks.
inclusion_reason: Maps agent evaluation by capability, application, benchmark dimension, and development framework for readers designing or auditing interactive evaluations.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Text-only scores do not establish whether an LLM agent can plan, call tools, retain state, recover from errors, and safely complete a user goal in a changing environment. Agent benchmarks also differ in task data, environment dynamics, interface, and success checks, making a headline success rate hard to interpret or compare. They can hide cascading failures, non-compliant actions, and costs incurred before an apparently correct final result.

The paper responds with a survey rather than a new benchmark. It maps core capabilities, application-specific and generalist evaluations, shared benchmark dimensions, and developer frameworks, then identifies gaps in granular, scalable, cost-aware, safe, and robust assessment for reproducible deployment decisions, transparent audit, cross-system review, practical use, and checking.

文本输出分数不能证明 LLM 智能体能否规划、调用工具、保持状态、从错误中恢复，并在变化环境中安全完成用户目标。智能体基准又在任务数据、环境动态性、交互接口和成功检查上不同，单一成功率难以解释或比较，还会掩盖级联失败、不合规动作及正确结果前消耗的成本。

论文以综述而非新基准回应：它映射核心能力、应用型与通用型评测、共同基准维度和开发者框架，并指出细粒度、可扩展、成本感知、安全与鲁棒评测的缺口，以支持可复现的部署决策、透明审计、跨系统复核、实际使用与检查。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central contribution is an evaluation map that links what an agent must do—planning, tool use, self-reflection, and memory—to where it acts—web, software engineering, science, conversation, or generalist settings—and to how a benchmark is constructed and judged. It treats data curation, environment, interface, metric, and safety as orthogonal design choices rather than treating all task-completion scores as equivalent.

No official downloadable dataset is released. The companion GitHub repository is a living literature index, not a benchmark, training corpus, or executable agent-evaluation package. The survey's reusable object is therefore an audit schema: record the task, stateful environment, action interface, terminal predicate, safety constraints, and related fields before interpreting a reported score or selecting a benchmark, and retain those choices in the report.

核心贡献是把“智能体要做什么”与“如何评测”连接：前者包括规划、工具使用、自我反思和记忆，后者覆盖网页、软件工程、科学、对话与通用场景，以及基准的构建和判定方式。它把数据整理、环境、接口、指标和安全视为正交设计选择，而不把所有任务完成率当成等价分数。

论文未发布官方可下载数据集；配套 GitHub 是动态文献索引，不是基准、训练语料或可执行的智能体评测包。因此可复用对象是审计 schema：解读分数或选择基准前，应记录任务、有状态环境、动作接口、终止条件、安全约束等事项，并保留在报告中。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Search and select. The authors search Google Scholar, ACL Anthology, HuggingFace Papers, and arXiv with agent-evaluation keywords, then perform forward/backward citation chasing. They include new benchmarks, evaluation frameworks, or significant evaluation methods and exclude agent architectures without a distinct evaluation contribution.
  1. Validate coverage. Domain experts, including creators of leading benchmarks and agent architectures, review the selected literature; conference acceptance is a quality signal, while high-impact preprints remain in scope.
  1. Organize capability and domain evidence. The survey groups evaluations of planning, tool use, self-reflection, and memory, then covers web, SWE, scientific, conversational, and generalist agents.
  1. Analyze benchmark design. It compares data curation, static/dynamic environment, code/tool/GUI interface, metric, and safety; terminal checks include unit tests, state matching, answer matching, or mixed criteria.
  1. Map framework granularity. It distinguishes final-response, stepwise, and trajectory assessment, and compares reference-based with reference-free judging. Reproduction requires pinning the paper version and rerunning the disclosed search/selection process; repository updates and expert consultation are time-dependent.

1. 检索与选择：作者在 Google Scholar、ACL Anthology、HuggingFace Papers、arXiv 用智能体评测关键词检索，再做前向和后向引文追踪；纳入新基准、评测框架或重要评测方法，排除没有独立评测贡献的智能体架构。
  1. 验证覆盖：领域专家及领先基准和架构创建者复核文献；顶会录用是质量信号，同时保留高影响预印本。
  1. 组织能力与领域证据：按规划、工具使用、自我反思、记忆分类，再覆盖网页、软件工程、科学、对话和通用智能体。
  1. 分析基准设计：比较数据整理、静态或动态环境、代码工具 GUI 接口、指标和安全；终止检查可为单元测试、状态匹配、答案匹配或混合规则。
  1. 映射框架粒度：区分最终回答、逐步和轨迹评测，并比较基于参考与无参考判定。复现需固定论文版本并重跑公开流程；仓库更新和专家咨询随时间变化。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Coverage evidence — The disclosed review protocol searches four academic sources, applies citation chasing, uses inclusion/exclusion criteria, and adds expert consultation. Its resulting structure spans four core abilities, five application/generalist areas, five benchmark dimensions, and development frameworks. This directly supports its claim to organize agent evaluation beyond a single benchmark family.

Design evidence — Table 1 compares eight representative benchmarks on curation, environment, interface, metric, and explicit safety. It shows, for example, that SWE-bench Verified uses hybrid data, a dynamic code environment, and unit tests, while tau-bench uses a dynamic tools interface, state matching, and explicit safety. The table supports design-level comparison, not a ranking of agents or a claim that one environment is universally superior; it also shows that explicit safety is absent from most listed rows.

覆盖证据：公开综述流程检索四个学术来源、进行引文追踪，使用纳入排除规则并加入专家咨询；产出结构涵盖四项核心能力、五类应用或通用场景、五个基准维度和开发框架，直接支持其不局限于单一基准家族的评测地图主张。

设计证据：表 1 从数据整理、环境、接口、指标和显式安全五项比较八个代表基准。例如 SWE-bench Verified 是混合数据、动态代码环境和单元测试；tau-bench 是动态工具接口、状态匹配且显式考虑安全。该表支持设计层面对照，不能用于智能体排名，也不能证明某类环境普遍更优；多数列出的基准并未显式纳入安全。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Many benchmark papers measure one agent domain or one capability. This survey's change is to connect those local evaluations to a common design vocabulary—curation, environment, interface, metric, and safety—and then place developer frameworks beside public benchmarks.

The contribution is a comparative taxonomy and review procedure, not a new environment, dataset, agent, or controlled leaderboard. Its distinctive value is making terminal verification and trajectory-evaluation choices visible when moving across web, SWE, tools, and generalist settings. It also connects public benchmark evaluation to development-time observability: final-response, stepwise, and trajectory assessment expose different failure information and different reference-based versus judge-based trade-offs, rather than merely adding another task list.

许多基准论文只测量一个智能体领域或一种能力。本文的变化是用数据整理、环境、接口、指标和安全这套共同设计语言连接局部评测，再把开发者框架与公开基准并列讨论。

贡献是比较分类与综述程序，不是新环境、数据集、智能体或受控排行榜。其独特价值在于跨网页、软件工程、工具和通用场景时，使终止验证与轨迹评测的选择可见。它还把公开基准与开发期可观测性相连：最终回答、逐步与轨迹评测暴露的失败信息不同，基于参考与基于 judge 的方案也各有取舍，而非仅增加一份任务清单。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Author-stated limitation — Agent evaluation changes unusually fast, so the survey is a snapshot and may omit recent or forthcoming benchmarks, frameworks, and findings. Use its maintained repository for discovery, but pin a paper version or repository date before making a coverage claim.

Author-stated limitation — Selection is representative rather than exhaustive, and the depth per benchmark/framework is constrained. For any benchmark choice, read its primary paper rather than inferring implementation, license, contamination controls, or safety coverage from the survey.

Curator audit risk — The taxonomy makes differences visible but does not normalize task difficulty, model, harness, prompt, retries, or budget. Compare results only after fixing those factors; otherwise a score can conflate backbone capability with scaffold design.

作者承认的局限：智能体评测变化极快，综述只是快照，可能遗漏近期或即将出现的基准、框架和结果。可用维护仓库发现文献，但提出覆盖主张前必须固定论文版本或仓库日期。

作者承认的局限：选择具有代表性而非穷尽性，单个基准或框架的分析深度受篇幅限制。选择基准时应读主论文，不能从综述推断实现、许可、污染控制或安全覆盖。

整理者审计风险：分类使差异可见，却不归一化任务难度、模型、harness、提示、重试或预算。比较分数前需固定这些因素，否则结果会混淆基础模型能力与脚手架设计。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For a benchmark designer, begin with the target agent and user goal, choose the paper's curation/environment/interface/metric/safety fields, then specify a terminal check such as unit tests, state matching, or answer matching. The output is a benchmark design sheet; success is that every action space and verifier is explicit. Do not use only final success rate for long-horizon diagnosis.

For an agent developer, log trajectories and evaluate final response, steps, and full trajectories separately; use reference paths only where they are feasible, and calibrate any reference-free LLM judge. The output is a failure report that localizes planning, tool, or execution errors. Do not compare runs whose model, harness, retry policy, or budget differs.

For literature discovery, use the GitHub index to locate current work, then verify each primary artifact and pin its version/date.

若设计基准，先固定目标智能体和用户目标，再选择数据整理、环境、接口、指标、安全字段，并写明单元测试、状态匹配或答案匹配等终止检查，输出基准设计表；成功标准是每个动作空间和验证器都明确。长程诊断不能只用最终成功率。

若开发智能体，应分别评测最终回答、步骤和完整轨迹；仅在可行处使用参考路径，并校准无参考的 LLM judge，输出定位规划、工具或执行错误的失败报告。模型、harness、重试政策或预算不同的运行不可直接比较。

若用于文献发现，可借 GitHub 索引定位新工作，再核验每个主 artifact 并固定版本或日期。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position — This is an evaluation map for interactive LLM agents, not a new agent benchmark or training dataset.
  1. Method handle — The review uses four search sources, citation chasing, selection criteria, and expert validation; its main axes are capability, application, benchmark dimension, and framework.
  1. Artifact handle — The official GitHub repository is a living literature index. It does not release a downloadable benchmark, training set, or executable evaluation suite.
  1. Evidence anchor — Table 1 compares eight benchmarks using five fields; SWE-bench Verified is hybrid/dynamic/code/unit-test/no-explicit-safety, while tau-bench is hybrid/dynamic/tools/state-match/explicit-safety. This is a design comparison, not an agent leaderboard.
  1. Reuse decision — Use it to write an evaluation protocol or audit checklist. Before reuse, pin the source version and independently verify environment, terminal predicate, safety rule, model/harness, retries, and budget.

1. 定位：这是交互式 LLM 智能体的评测地图，不是新智能体基准或训练数据集。
  1. 方法抓手：综述使用四个检索来源、引文追踪、选择标准和专家验证；主轴是能力、应用、基准维度与框架。
  1. Artifact 抓手：官方 GitHub 是动态文献索引，不发布可下载基准、训练集或可执行评测套件。
  1. 证据锚点：表 1 用五字段比较八个基准；SWE-bench Verified 是混合动态代码单元测试无显式安全，tau-bench 是混合动态工具状态匹配显式安全。这是设计对照，不是智能体榜单。
  1. 复用决定：适合撰写评测协议或审计清单；复用前固定来源版本并独立核验环境、终止条件、安全规则、模型与 harness、重试和预算。
